recommended_parameters.fit_scope: normal restitution only; friction/time retained as priors

decision.message_zh: 已改用连续下落位置历史重建状态并完成 MJX 首次反弹位置回放，但五组的候选参数仍未通过留一录制稳定性门槛；本轮不覆盖生产 XML。

full_drop_validation.method: rest release from v_impact^2/(2g), gravity flight, static racket, first rebound only

mjx_validation.note: friction and solref time remain fixed because the recordings do not observe ball spin or millisecond contact force/duration

historical_fall_reconstruction.method: release-to-impact fresh positions -> robust continuous paper gravity/drag state; causal leave-tail-out validation; first rebound positions only

mjx_history_replay.backend: MJX history-state full drop and first-rebound position replay
mjx_history_replay.initialization: fitted state at the first measured falling sample; rigid position-history alignment at detected impact; no v^2/(2g) release-height inference
mjx_history_replay.flight_force: per-record local gravity plus paper quadratic drag applied as MJX xfrc
mjx_history_replay.target: continuous first-rebound normal positions, not logged velocity
